title: Google Trends input
description: Get Google Trends data for any search terms: interest over time, by region, related queries and topics, plus ready-made insights. Optionally add today's trending searches for any country.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords or phrases to look up. You can also use Google Knowledge Graph topic IDs such as /m/05p0rrx (Bitcoin the topic), which Google treats more precisely than plain text.

compareTerms.title: Compare terms against each other
compareTerms.description: On: terms share one 0–100 scale, in groups of up to 5 (Google's limit) — use this to see which term is bigger. Off: every term gets its own report and its own scale.

geos.title: Countries or regions
geos.description: Two-letter country codes (US, DE, LT) or regions (US-CA, GB-ENG). Each location gets its own report. Leave empty for worldwide; add WORLDWIDE to include it alongside countries.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Period to analyse. Choose Custom to set exact dates below.

customTimeRange.title: Custom time range
customTimeRange.description: Used only when Time range is Custom. Dates: "2024-01-01 2024-12-31". Hours (UTC, within the past week): "2026-10-10T08 2026-10-12T20".

category.title: Category ID
category.description: Google Trends category to search in (0 = all). Find the ID in the cat= part of a Trends URL, e.g. 7 = Finance, 5 = Computers & Electronics.

includeInterestOverTime.title: Interest over time
includeInterestOverTime.description: Timeline of search interest (0–100), with peak, latest value and recent momentum calculated for you.

includeInterestByRegion.title: Interest by region
includeInterestByRegion.description: Where each term is searched most.

regionResolution.title: Region breakdown
regionResolution.description: Automatic picks countries for worldwide searches, regions/states for a country, and cities for a region.

includeLowVolumeRegions.title: Include low-volume regions
includeLowVolumeRegions.description: Also return regions with little search volume.

includeRelatedQueries.title: Related queries
includeRelatedQueries.description: Top and rising searches people make alongside each term, including "Breakout" queries (growth over 5000%).

includeRelatedTopics.title: Related topics
includeRelatedTopics.description: Top and rising related topics, with Knowledge Graph IDs.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: Reports: one rich JSON item per term (best for APIs and AI agents). Spreadsheet rows: one flat row per date, region, query and topic (best for CSV, Excel and Google Sheets). The price is the same.

trendingNowGeos.title: Trending now: countries
trendingNowGeos.description: Two-letter country codes (US, GB, DE…). Returns today's trending searches with traffic estimates and news links. Works with or without search terms.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for topic names and date labels, e.g. en-US, de, lt.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel sessions
maxConcurrency.description: How many reports to fetch at once, each through its own IP. Higher is faster for long lists but invites more rate-limiting.

maxAttemptsPerRequest.title: Max attempts per request
maxAttemptsPerRequest.description: How many fresh IPs to try when Google rate-limits a request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are strongly recommended: Google rate-limits datacenter IPs quickly.
